_comment: Drop this into .claude/settings.json (per-project) or merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (per-user). Adjust paths and permissions to taste.
_handoff_note: ORCH_CONTEXT_HANDOFF_TOKENS is the token count at which the agent is reminded once to write a handoff note (a short status file) so a long task can continue cleanly after Claude Code compacts the conversation. Default 950000 (~95% of a 1M-token window), just below the point where native compaction kicks in. Lower it for a smaller window. You can also write the note anytime with /llm-orchestrator:handoff.
_hooks_note: If you installed via --copy (not as a plugin), add hook entries here using Claude Code's settings.json hook schema. See docs/install.md → 'Wiring hooks for a --copy install' for the full example. If you installed as a plugin, hooks come from .claude-plugin/plugin.json automatically — leave this block out.
